_meta.description: Seed race data for Carrera Monterrey (Running App MVP). Real 2026-2027 races in Monterrey / Nuevo León, compiled via research agents and deduped across three sources (AANL calendar, Idemsport, Asdeporte, Hub Sports, TriTour, official race sites). Second sweep 2026-07-04: added Idemsport/AANL calendar races missed in the first pass (excluded one employees-only private event). CDMX/EdoMex sweep 2026-07-05: 3-angle fan-out per the Race Research Playbook (flagship, aggregators, trail), deduped.
_meta.warning: Dates/times for medium/low-confidence entries were not fully confirmed for the 2026-2027 edition. Verify against signupUrl before trusting. Fields left null were not confirmable (never guessed).
_meta.linkSweep: 2026-07-04: registration links verified via runera.mx (reliable for Trotime SPA GUIDs) and asdeporte.com. Organizer patterns: Asdeporte publishes ~5-6 months ahead; Trotime a few months. Unverified GUIDs stay in notes, not signupUrl.
